confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded from search results that are mostly 2025-2026 guides and crowd-sourced cost sites that disagree with each other; the cappuccino figure is partly inferred. Sources quoted euros, and I converted to USD at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15 without a search, so the USD values carry that FX assumption. Accommodation anchors (hostel_dorm_1p, hostel_private_2p, hotel_1star_2p, hotel_3star_2p) are holistic model estimates for July demand. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages (exchange-rates overview and homepage) that show 0.6955 at 4.00pm on 2026-10-15. I did not open the RBA table directly, and an earlier RBA-table search returned only March 2026 data, so the rate may be cached.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct single-source price survey exists for Barcelona in July 2026. Restaurant and drink anchors are anchored to Barcelona-specific guide and crowd-sourced figures. Accommodation is a holistic estimate comparable to other large southern European tourist cities (for example Valencia, Lisbon, Milan) in peak summer, adjusted for Barcelona's high July demand.
